description:
One. Last. Game.

Watch the **JUMANJI: OPEN WORLD Final Trailer (2026)**, as Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black and Karen Gillan return for one final adventure in the world of Jumanji.

This time, the game isn't keeping its players trapped inside — **Jumanji is breaking free into the real world**, unleashing dangerous creatures, chaos and the rules of the game upon civilization. With the worlds of Jumanji and reality colliding, the group must reunite and complete their most dangerous game yet before it's too late.

🎬 **JUMANJI: OPEN WORLD (2026)**
📅 **In Theaters December 25, 2026**
⭐ **Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black, Karen Gillan**
⭐ Alex Wolff, Madison Iseman, Morgan Turner, Ser'Darius Blain
⭐ Nick Jonas & Danny DeVito
🎥 Directed by **Jake Kasdan**
🌴 Action / Adventure / Comedy
🏢 Sony Pictures

**Jumanji: Open World** serves as the final chapter of the modern Jumanji trilogy following **Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle** and **Jumanji: The Next Level**.
